decisions.reason: Correcting the token ID displayed by the mint success popup does not change fiat buyers' wallet, dashboard, commission, ticket, or prize access behavior.
The source changes confirmation-display accuracy, not the USDC approval-to-mint flow or its successful-mint outcome.
The reported popup token ID concerns a USDC wallet attempt and does not change the deferred Transak fiat-mint provider or conversion flow.
The actual token ID shown after minting has no effect on the $15 mint price or its pricing conditions.
The source specifically reports a popup problem during USDC approval and does not alter the ETH-to-USDC conversion or refund behavior.
Correcting the displayed minted token ID does not change allocation of primary-sale proceeds.
The source does not change the NFT ebook product type or unlimited supply model; it changes only the success confirmation's displayed token ID.
The confirmation-display correction does not change background wallet creation, custody, key control, or seed-phrase requirements for fiat buyers.
The source does not change which payment methods are selectable or unavailable.
The source does not alter payment-currency disclosure or selection between ETH and USDC.
The popup's token ID accuracy does not affect optional tipping, preset amounts, custom tips, or placement.
Although the source mentions the current mint number, it does not change which prior token IDs are valid referral codes or the self-referral rule.
